title: ItzKits
body:
**ItzKits** is a powerful and easy-to-use Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to create and manage custom player kits with ease. Whether you're running a survival, PvP, faction, or minigame server, ItzKits provides a flexible way to distribute predefined item sets to players.

Here is all the info you need to use this plugin.
Commands:
- **/kits** - open menu with all the kits
- **/kiteditor <kit>** - open menu where you can customize your personal layout of this kit in order as you want
- **/kit create <kit name>** - creates a kit with your whole inventory and all the items data saved
- **/kit remove <kit name>** - remove the kit
- **/kit give <player> <kit name>** - directly give the kit to any player and bypasses the occupied slots check
- **/kit reload** - reload any changes made from config
- **/kit edit <kit name> icon** - set held item as icon
- **/kit edit <kit name> slot <1-28>** - move kit to different slot in the /kits menu
- **/kit edit <kit name> allowpreview <true/false>** - allow preview of this kit in /kits (default: true)
- **/kit edit <kit name> displayname <new name>** - set displayname of this kit for /kits menu
- **/kit edit <kit name> name <new name>** - rename kit
- **/kit edit <kit name> setcooldown <time>** - custom cooldown before equipping the kit
- **/kit edit <kit name> kiteditor <off/kitaccess/always>** - off = disable kit editor for this kit, kitaccess = kit editor avaible only for players with permissions to use the kit, always = anyone can you kiteditor for this kit (default: always)
- **/kit edit <kit name> usagepermission <true/false>** - set if the kit requires permission to be used (default: true)

Permissions:
- **itzkits.admin** - full access to all commands (default: op)
- **itzkits.give** - access to /kit give (default: false)
- **itzkits.use** - access to /kits and /kiteditor (default: true)
- **itzkits.usekit.<kit name>** - access to use this kit
- **itzkits.bypasscd.<kit name>** - bypass cooldown of this kit

Features:
- Up to **28** custom kits
- Easy to use and configurable
- Display name **supports color gradients**
- Can be manually edited from config
- Prevent player from claiming the kit if at least one of the slots is occupied
- Per player custom layout of each kit using **/kiteditor**
